data.gender_notes: Evars is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin word 'evarus', meaning 'youthful' or 'full of energy'. In Christian tradition, this name is associated with the young and vibrant spirit of St. Evaristus, a martyr and bishop. The name Evars carries the meaning “Youth, vigor” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Evars usually hope their child will grow to embody youth, vigor and live with faith, good character and purpose.
